businesses.business: consumer money transfer and payment services

offering_description.value: Provides cross-border and domestic money transfer, bill payment and related consumer financial services. Serves individual consumers mainly sending money to family abroad, plus some businesses, through a network of agent locations, digital apps and websites. Operates its own transfer and payments network and earns fees and foreign exchange spreads.

primary_services.value: consumer money transfers; digital money transfer via app and web; bill payments; prepaid and stored-value cards; business payments and foreign exchange

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers and migrant workers sending remittances, paying bills, or using money services; B2B: small businesses and financial institutions using payment, foreign exchange and payout services

end_markets.value: consumer remittances; retail financial services; digital payments; cross-border payments

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: transfer fees charged per money transfer and bill payment transaction; other: foreign exchange spread earned on currency conversion in cross-border transfers; service fees: business payment and card program services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; other; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: moves funds between senders and recipients through agent and digital network, selling to consumers and businesses; asset operator: operates global payments network and settlement infrastructure plus a smaller set of company-owned retail locations

geography_served.value: global: over 200 countries and territories, with large markets in the US, Europe, Latin America, Asia and Africa

specialization.value: related lines: consumer money transfer, bill payment, prepaid cards and business payments sharing the same network

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: third-party agent locations such as retailers, post offices and banks; online: branded website and mobile app for digital money transfer; own locations: company-owned retail branches in some markets; direct sales: sales team for business payments and financial institution partners
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; online; own locations; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed money transmitter, regulated by CFPB, FinCEN, state regulators, and foreign regulators under AML, sanctions and consumer protection rules

notes: Company has been shifting its portfolio (e.g., Intermex acquisition announced 2025, sold business solutions unit in 2023); details may have changed.
